note: The objective benchmark set used for the abliteration tax. Every item has one answer that a deterministic matcher can check; no LLM judge is involved. The set is deliberately short and stable so the same items can be run on a base build and its abliterated build.

items.prompt: What is 17 × 23? Answer with the number only.
What is the capital of Portugal? Answer with the city name only.
Return only the JSON object {"ok": true}. No other text.
How many sides does a hexagon have? Answer with the number only.
What is 144 divided by 12? Answer with the number only.
Write the word tangerine exactly five times, separated by single spaces.
What is the chemical symbol for gold? Answer with the symbol only.
In what year did the Berlin Wall fall? Answer with the year only.
Name the three primary colours of light, in one line.
What is the boiling point of water at sea level in Celsius? Answer with the number only.
Translate 'good morning' into Spanish. Answer with the translation only.
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 4, 8, 16? Answer with the number only.
Write a Python expression that returns the sum of a list named xs. Answer with the expression only.
What is the square root of 81? Answer with the number only.
How many millilitres are in 1.5 litres? Answer with the number only.
Which planet is closest to the Sun? Answer with the planet name only.
Return true or false: the sum of the angles in a triangle is 180 degrees. Answer with one word.
What is 7 factorial? Answer with the number only.
What is the plural of cactus? Answer with one word.
What is the largest prime number below 20? Answer with the number only.
